verifications.claim: Dusty May is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Michigan.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Dusty May David and Meredith Kaplan Men's Basketball Head Coach" (R1); "Title Head coach Team Michigan" and "currently the Wolverines men's basketball head coach at the University of Michigan" (R2); "Dusty May was named the David and Meredith Kaplan Men’s Basketball Head Coach" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Dusty May is the current head coach at Michigan.

verifications.claim: Dusty May was hired on March 26, 2024.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "On March 23, 2024, May was named the 18th head basketball coach" (R2); "named ... in March 2024" (R3); references to March 23 and March 24 announcements (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify March 23 or 24, 2024, directly contradicting March 26.

verifications.claim: Dusty May was hired to replace Juwan Howard.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "He was hired by Michigan in 2024, replacing Juwan Howard" (R2); Juwan Howard 2019–24 followed by Dusty May 2024–present (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state May replaced Howard.

verifications.claim: Dusty May led the Wolverines to a National Championship in his second season (2026).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "NCAA Division I National Championship with the Wolverines in 2026"; "2025–26 Michigan 37–3 ... NCAA Division I Champion" (R2); "leads Michigan to the 2026 national title" (R4); "2026 NCAA Tournament Championship" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm national championship in 2026, May's second season (2025-26).

verifications.claim: Dusty May had a stint at Florida Atlantic.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "2018–2024 Florida Atlantic" (R2); "head coaching job at Florida Atlantic ... (2018-24)" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm head coaching stint at Florida Atlantic from 2018-2024.
